mathematics.assertion_tested: Bounded linear wave-packet evolution of the exact-kernel effective polarization model: test energy conservation, local radiation escape, and vacuum zero modes.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64/complex128; analytic Fourier-mode time evolution
mathematics.conventions: Dimensionless C=a0=Z=I=1, one longitudinal spatial dimension, periodic length 512. Uniform background. Imported kernel definition is the repaired CFG596 formula, reproduced explicitly; not the different CFG597 nu_mono.

criteria.local_escape: central perturbation-energy fraction below 0.10 at t=150 for that background only
criteria.vacuum: A nonzero stationary zero-energy null perturbation disproves strict linear attraction at vacuum; not nonlinear stability or instability.

controls: Negative quadratic mismatch a=0.99 must yield a negative eigenvalue
non_claims: No microscopic identification, derived Z/I or physical time unit
No nonlinear, spherical, cosmological, lensing or data calculation
Radiation leaves only the central window, not the periodic system
No damping, equilibrium selection or full theory claimed
